<thought>Only carbon shows a clear multi‑peak isotopic envelope (M, M+1, M+2 …) with the observed decreasing intensities. No characteristic Cl, Br, or S patterns are present, and other elements have isotopic contributions too small to be seen. Thus the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
